preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 2000 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit() and len(line.split()) > 1)])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (1 <= n <= 2000) representing the number of vertices.
For each test case with n vertices, there are exactly n-1 lines following, each containing two integers x and y (1 <= x, y <= n) representing an edge.
The given edges for each test case form a valid tree (connected, acyclic, n-1 edges).
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and int(line) >= 0 for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer.

For each test case, the output integer is the minimum number of queries k required to uniquely identify any hidden vertex x in the given tree. Specifically, k is the smallest integer such that there exists a set of k vertices {v_1, ..., v_k} where the vector of distances (dist(v_1, x), ..., dist(v_k, x)) is unique for every vertex x in the tree.
